what: R5 (PLAN.md 10.8) training plan, sealed 2026-11-02 before any R5 training. Fixes the choices so none is tuned on held-out data.
segmenter: nnU-Net v2 2.8.1, Dataset602_MRHeadR5 = round 1's train cases (SynthRAD + Sun Yat-sen, data/manifests/round1.json) + the IXI train and val heads of the sealed r5_ixi_split whose charm run finished; held out (imagesTs): round 1's test cases and the IXI test heads. Trainer nnUNetTrainerHMThick (nnUNetTrainer, 250 epochs = round 1's pilot result reused, no new epoch selection; + ThickSliceTransform p=0.3, slab k ~ U[2,6] voxels along one random axis). 3d_fullres, nnU-Net's default plans and 5-fold split (seed 12345), all 5 folds, checkpoint_final of each. Labels charm's tissue_labeling_upsampled on the T1 grid (block majority, or the general majority vote for IXI).
warp: R5 warp net = warpnet.py's model and loss, trained on the out-of-fold predicted labels (nnU-Net fold_N/validation) of every training head (round 1 train + IXI train), T1 as input; the loss weight of the 10 targets, the 13 rTMS EEG positions and 4 fiducials raised (value fixed in the warp training rule, sealed before the warp training); validation = the 30 WP3b val cases + the 30 IXI val heads, out-of-fold labels; the SVF refinement as adopted (round 4).
rule: Nothing in this plan is changed after any R5 result is seen, except by a new sealed amendment that says why. The end-to-end scoring rule (gate, sets, order: validation pilot, then the fresh IXI test set once, then the 57 for comparison) is sealed before any R5 model is scored.
no_folding: not judged here; the end-to-end scoring rule states it (written-map min Jacobian > 0 on every case).
